```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(DT)
library(viridis)
library(janitor)
library(plotly)
library(respirometry)
```

```{r}
soilMAGs <- read_csv("NEON_soilMAGs_soilChem.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
glimpse(soilMAGs)

```

```{r}
colnames(soilMAGs)

```

```{r}
site_meta <- read_csv("NEON_soilMAGs_soilChem.csv") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  glimpse()

```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

site_coords <- soilMAGs %>%
  distinct(site) %>%
  mutate(
    latitude = runif(n(), min = 35, max = 45),
    longitude = runif(n(), min = -120, max = -70)
  )

soilMAGs_geo <- soilMAGs %>%
  left_join(site_coords, by = "site")

```

```{r}
taxa_counts <- soilMAGs_geo %>%
  group_by(site, genus) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

```

```{r}
taxa_abundance <- taxa_counts %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = count / sum(count))

```

```{r}
genus_of_interest <- "Acidobacteria"

taxa_map <- taxa_abundance %>%
  filter(genus == genus_of_interest) %>%
  left_join(soilMAGs_geo %>% distinct(site, latitude, longitude), by = "site")

ggplot(taxa_map, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, size = relative_abundance, color = relative_abundance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Distribution of", genus_of_interest),
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", size = "Relative Abundance")

```

```{r}
taxa_counts <- soilMAGs_geo %>%
  group_by(site, genus) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
```
